title: Podcast EP377: Aion Silicon's Growth and Impact Across Multiple Markets with Oliver Jones
text:

Categories: Aion Silicon, Semiconductor Services

Daniel is joined by Oliver Jones, CEO of Aion Silicon, a global semiconductor design and engineering company delivering custom silicon solutions for the AI age. He leads the company’s strategy and growth as it continuously helps technology companies bring advanced SoC designs to market from architecture through production, across datacenter, automotive, and edge computing markets.
Daniel explores the growth and shift in business model as Sondrel became Aion Silicon with Oliver. Oliver describes the shift from design services to a full-service ASIC provider and details Aion Silicon’s business growth across multiple markets. Oliver explains that custom silicon needs for AI data centers are driving much of the company’s new business. He expects this will expand to include edge computing as well.
This in-depth discussion explores the attributes that make Aion Silicon unique. Beyond the company’s strong skills in advanced technology, two key differentiators are that Aion Silicon does not compete with its customers and that the company is fab agnostic.
